Specification: This module defines two helper operators over the state space or data structures provided by the imported Reachable module. It chooses a successor function from Nodes to subsets of Nodes such that every node has exactly two successors, and it defines a set of finite sequences over an arbitrary set S whose lengths are bounded by the cardinality of Nodes. The module contains no variables, no actions, no temporal specification, and no proofs; it is a small structural helper module rather than a complete transition-system specification.
ChoiceExpr:
CHOOSE succ \in [Nodes -> SUBSET Nodes]
  : \A n \in Nodes : Cardinality(succ[n]) = 2
